full_name: Eloy Enciso | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Filmmaker (Spain)
bio: Eloy Enciso is a filmmaker based in Galicia, Spain. His work is located within that vein of cinema—from Robert J. Flaherty to current work coming out of Harvard’s Sensory Ethnography Lab—that seeks not so much to explain other cultures as to provide an immersive experience of them. Mixing an ethnographic approach with drama, his films show the lyric intertwining of fact and fiction.
